categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `contrib/verify-binaries/`, the release-verification tooling under contrib that guards release integrity.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security flaw where expired and revoked GPG keys satisfied the release verification quorum. As reported by the Red Team disclosure, the verifier counted revoked keys toward `--min-good-sigs`, which could allow binaries to pass verification even if all signatures were from compromised keys.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py` and its tests.
categories.rationale: Corrects key-validation logic in a critical contrib verification tool. The script previously counted expired and revoked keys as good signatures toward quorum; this change excludes inactive keys by default while adding `--allow-expired` for older releases.
